title: Argentinian Kidney Beans Pilaf
description: A light and juicy Argentinian dish featuring kidney beans, cooked to perfection in a papillote with butter and spices, resulting in a deliciously tender and flavorful pilaf.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soaked and drained kidney beans, chopped onion, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
In a large piece of aluminum foil, create a papillote by folding the foil in half and pressing the edges together to form a seal.
Add the kidney bean mixture to the center of the papillote, then add the butter and chicken broth.
Fold the papillote over the filling, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Carefully open the papillote and serve the kidney beans pilaf hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
